title: Finite type modules on a ringed space: stable under epimorphic images and extensions (Stacks 01B7)
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space (for instance a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its structure sheaf) and $\mathit{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules on the open sets of $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. An $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ is *of finite type* if every point $x\in X$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ and finitely many sections $s_1,\dots,s_n\in\mathcal F(U)$ such that the associated map $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal F|_U$, $e_i\mapsto s_i$, is an epimorphism of $\mathcal O_U$-modules (Stacks, Modules, Definition 01B5; the notion of [pqf-def-coherent] (2)). Then: (1) if $p:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ is an epimorphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and $\mathcal F$ is of finite type, then $\mathcal G$ is of finite type (in particular the image of a morphism whose source is of finite type is of finite type); (2) if $0\to\mathcal F_1\to\mathcal F_2\to\mathcal F_3\to0$ is a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] and $\mathcal F_1$ and $\mathcal F_3$ are of finite type, then $\mathcal F_2$ is of finite type.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01B7 (label lemma-extension-finite-type, line 855) with its proof ('the statement on images is trivial'; extensions: sections of F_3 locally lift to F_2, and the corresponding result for modules over a ring); Definition 01B5 (definition-finite-type, line 810).
